claims.quote: the faceplate of the Telephot became luminous, revealing the face of a clean shaven man about thirty, a pleasant but serious face.
claims.description: Person-to-person two-way video telephone ('Telephot') connecting individuals across the world.

claims.quote: He immediately turned the small shining disc of the Language Rectifier on his instrument till the pointer rested on "French."
claims.description: A device that translates speech in real time between languages during intercontinental video calls.

claims.quote: Ralph then attached the Telautograph to his Telephot while the girl did the same. When both instruments were connected he signed his name and he saw his signature appear simultaneously on the machine in Switzerland.
claims.description: Remote handwriting transmission, so a signature written in New York appears instantly on a device in Switzerland.

claims.quote: The delicate detectophone mechanism of the Luminor responded instantly to her command; and the room was flooded at once with the beautiful cold pink-white Luminor-light, emanating from the thin wire running around the four sides of the room below the white ceiling.
claims.description: Voice-controlled, cold electric room lighting from a wire strip, with dimming by spoken command.

claims.quote: It must be a dreadful predicament to be cut off from the entire world, in these days of weather control.
claims.description: Human control of the weather is routine.

claims.quote: they simultaneously turned on the high-depression at the four Meteoro-Towers and then fled, leaving their towers with the high-tension currents escaping at a tremendous rate.
claims.description: Weather-engineers operating electrical towers that generate pressure systems, snow and blizzards over a district, enabling weather to be used as a weapon in a labor dispute.

claims.quote: The other Meteoros, I believe, will start in immediately to direct a low-pression over our district; but, as they are not very near us, it will probably take them twenty-four hours to generate enough heat to melt the snow and ice.
claims.description: Networked weather towers directing heat energy over a distance to melt snow and ice and correct weather.

claims.quote: they finally had to be dismantled by directed energy from forty other Meteoro-Towers, which directed a tremendous amount of energy against the four local towers, till the latter were fused and melted.
claims.description: Directed-energy transmission from towers to destroy distant structures.

claims.quote: I managed to put the light magnesium power mast into a temporary position again, and I had just called up the Teleservice Company, telling them again to direct the power
claims.description: Wireless power broadcast via masts, with power directed to individual homes by a utility.

claims.quote: The storm was so terrific that no aeroflyer could come near the house; I have never seen such a thing.
claims.description: Personal flying vehicles ('aeroflyers') used for ordinary travel between Switzerland and Paris.

claims.quote: He glanced at the calendar. It was September 1st in the year 2660.
claims.description: Setting of the story in a technologically advanced world of the year 2660.

claims.quote: approaching that of the huge Martians.
claims.description: Existence of a race of huge Martians known to humanity.

claims.quote: one of the ten men on the whole planet earth permitted to use the Plus sign after his name
claims.description: A global honor system limiting the plus-sign title to ten top scientists.

claims.quote: Autograph-hunting women he usually dismissed with a curt refusal.
claims.description: Telephot-era celebrity culture enabling remote autograph-seeking via video link.

claims.quote: I really sometimes envy our ancestors, who, I believe, heated their houses with stoves, burning strange black rocks or tree-chunks in them!
claims.description: Stoves and coal/wood heating are obsolete, replaced by electric heaters.

claims.quote: There is nothing known to science out of which the time machine could be developed
claims.description: Claim that a time machine cannot be developed from known science.
